projectState.summary: Claude approved codex/byte-song-library-a and it was fast-forward merged/pushed to main. On the new branch codex/byte-wild-song-draft-a, the first bolder spike is implemented: starter-generated songs now produce full-form relational SongMaterial instead of 16-beat loops. SongMaterial has optional starter-full-form metadata with phraseBeats, relationTags, full-form melody mode, and rootPlans. song-form uses draft rootPlans for harmonic context, and full-form draft melody bypasses the old canned chorus/bridge hook while default/canned songs keep prior behavior. src/song-starter-material.ts now generates pulse/bass/melody patterns over the active form length (e.g. Wide Return = 176 beats) using dimensions like breath debt, bridge rupture/shadow, asymmetric roles, and return acceleration/softening. Safety line: deterministic, integer scale degrees, existing lookahead path, no new scheduler/audio/persistence path. Validation: npm run build, focused song-library smoke, npm run smoke (78/78), npm run db:smoke, git diff --check all green; npm audit still reports known Vite/esbuild advisories.
